2607.26698.title: MPEcho: A Melody and Phoneme-Aware Generative Framework for Controllable Cover Song Generation
2607.26698.paper_summary: Cover song generation (CSG) should preserve the melodic and linguistic content of a reference song while recreating the remaining musical components. The state-of-the-art model SongEcho utilizes $F_0$ sequences and voiced/unvoiced (V/UV) tags for conditioning; however, implicit linguistic information from V/UV tags cannot guarantee lyric accuracy, leading to a high phoneme error rate (PER). Inspired by singing voice synthesis (SVS), we propose MPEcho, which integrates a phoneme encoder and a length regulator (LR) into the SongEcho framework. By providing explicit phoneme-level conditioning and precise temporal boundaries, MPEcho significantly reduces PER. To enable this, we developed Phonsa, a Whisper-based automatic transcription model that provides high-precision phoneme-level annotations for singing voices, overcoming the scarcity of high-quality audio-phoneme pairs. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of Phonsa for alignment and MPEcho for end-to-end CSG. The audio samples, code and weights can be accessed from https://lonian6.github.io/MPEcho.github.io/.
2607.26698.paper_summary_zh: 翻唱歌曲生成（CSG）應該保留參考歌曲的旋律和語言內容，同時重現其餘的音樂成分。最先進的模型 SongEcho 利用 $F_0$ 序列和有聲/無聲（V/UV）標籤進行條件化；然而，來自 V/UV 標籤的隱含語言信息無法保證歌詞的準確性，導致高音素錯誤率（PER）。受到歌聲合成（SVS）的啟發，我們提出了 MPEcho，該模型將音素編碼器和長度調節器（LR）整合進 SongEcho 框架中。通過提供明確的音素級條件和精確的時間邊界，MPEcho 顯著降低了 PER。為了實現這一點，我們開發了 Phonsa，一種基於 Whisper 的自動轉錄模型，為歌聲提供高精度的音素級註釋，克服了高質量音頻-音素對的稀缺性。實驗結果驗證了 Phonsa 在對齊方面的有效性以及 MPEcho 在端到端 CSG 中的有效性。音頻樣本、代碼和權重可以從 https://lonian6.github.io/MPEcho.github.io/ 獲取。
